# Logo Maker

Logo maker: design logo concepts from your brand name, business, style and colors. Up to four options per run, generated as image files you can download.

## What it does
Give the brand name, what the business does, a style (minimal, emblem, mascot, wordmark...) and colors. Claude prepares the brief, tells you the price, and creates up to four concepts per run in your account.

**How the files are made:** each logo concept is generated by an image model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Outputs are raster images (PNG). Check a logo's availability as a trademark before using it.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install logo-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Logo Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/logo/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each logo concept uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The logo concepts show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_logo_models` | Models for logos with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_logo_cost` | Exact price of one logo before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_logo` | Starts one logo in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_logo` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A minimal logo for Northwind Coffee, a specialty roaster, navy and cream"
- "Mascot logo for a kids' coding school called Byte Club"
- "Three emblem concepts for a craft brewery named Old Anchor"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the logo concept (the brand name, the business, the colors and the symbol idea) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
